en.title: Sleepless Court, Echoes of Frenzy
en.premise: "Night Legends" is a street basketball team of working adults that operates out of a sports center late at night. Amidst the adversity of missing their star players, the story follows the intersecting perspectives of a bench player tirelessly recording data and the spectators hungry for excitement. Set against the backdrop of a sleepless city's bustle, they prepare to take on a tournament held on the night of the region's largest festival. A tale of light and shadow, following those who stake everything on a single moment of play.

zh.title: 不眠球场，狂热残响
zh.premise: “夜之传奇”是一支以深夜运动中心为据点、由社会人士组成的街头篮球队。在主力缺阵的逆境中，始终在板凳席记录数据的替补球员，与渴望狂热气氛的观众，两者的视角交织在一起。在不夜城的喧嚣背景下，他们向在当地最大祭典之夜举办的锦标赛发起挑战。这是一个关于将一切赌在瞬间动作之上的，光与影的故事。
